events.title: Robowar
events.description: Design and build a robot for head-to-head combat, using offensive and defensive capabilities to outmaneuver, disable, or defeat the opponent.

events.title: Rapid Line (LFR)
events.description: Design and race a fully autonomous Line Follower Robot to navigate a pre-laid track with turns, gaps, and surface variations in the shortest time.

events.title: Sky Maneuver
events.description: Design and manually pilot a quadcopter through an obstacle course, execute a precision payload drop, and demonstrate stable hovering without GPS or autonomous flight.

events.title: Hovermania
events.description: Design and build a remote-controlled hovercraft that floats through a given trackway, navigating turns, junctions, and terrains without excessive sway.

events.title: RoboSoccer
events.description: Build a soccer-playing robot to dribble, defend, and score in a fast-paced 1v1 robotic showdown blending precision, strategy, and speed.

events.title: RC Boat
events.description: Design and build a wirelessly controlled, battery-powered boat to navigate a water-based obstacle course with speed, stability, and maneuverability.

events.title: RC Car
events.description: Design and manually operate a remote-controlled car to complete a dynamic obstacle course in the shortest time, testing speed, handling, and maneuvering.

events.title: Micromouse Challenge
events.description: Design, build, and program a fully autonomous Micromouse robot to solve an unknown maze from start to centre in minimum time.

events.title: Competitive Programming Marathon
events.description: An intense, endurance-based competitive programming event for algorithm enthusiasts, testing analytical and mathematical thinking under pressure.

events.title: Ghost Code
events.description: A reverse-engineering challenge to decode broken or mysterious code—what it does, or should do. Tests debugging, pattern recognition, and analytical skills.

events.title: Pixel Wizard
events.description: A test of coding, creativity, and design skills by creating website clones using specific tech stacks.

events.title: Machine Learning Model
events.description: Design and present a machine learning model that solves a given problem, judged on innovation and implementation.

events.title: Debug & Deploy (Diploma Students Only)
events.description: Tackle real-time coding issues and deploy solutions on the spot. From logical bugs to syntax errors, this event simulates real-world development. (Diploma Students Only)

events.title: AI Chit-Chat
events.description: A competition to build chatbots using AI models—craft digital companions that interact meaningfully.

events.title: Kritrim - Model Exhibition

events.title: Hackathon
events.description: A presentation-based competition where teams develop innovative solutions for given problems and present them, judged on creativity, originality, and clarity.

events.title: Jugaad

events.title: BGMI
events.description: A competitive battle-royale event focused on teamwork, strategy, and quick decision-making.

events.title: Free Fire
events.description: A fast-paced squad battle where players compete using strategy, coordination, and combat skills.

events.title: Chess
events.description: A strategic one-on-one mind game that tests planning, concentration, and decision-making.

events.title: Pitchverse
events.description: Present an innovative startup idea or prototype that solves a real-world problem, highlighting its feasibility, impact, and potential.

events.title: Case Crack

events.title: Brand Blitz
events.description: Create and present an effective marketing strategy for a given brand or product.

events.title: Case Ethical Crosstalk
events.description: Analyze a given ethical dilemma, take a stand, and defend your decision through logical arguments.

events.title: Innovation-X
events.description: A 10-12 day innovation sprint where teams develop a functional MVP for a real-world problem and pitch it.

events.title: Arduino Imagino

events.title: Soldering Speedrun
events.description: Race against time to solder a given circuit with speed, accuracy, and precision.

events.title: Breadboard Battle
events.description: Test your electronics knowledge and practical skills by designing circuits on a breadboard.

events.title: Grid Masters - SLD Challenge
events.description: Design, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical power system single line diagrams.

events.title: WPTC - Wireless Power Transfer
events.description: Design and build a wireless power transfer system to power a given load.

events.title: Mechnovate
events.description: Select a real-world mechanical problem and present an innovative solution with strong presentation skills.

events.title: Designare
events.description: An exploration of 3D design—craft models that blend aesthetics with functionality.

events.title: Hydraload
events.description: Engineer hydraulic systems grounded in fluid mechanics, pressure dynamics, and force distribution.

events.title: Fabriquer
events.description: Fabricate machines that embody precision, efficiency, and ingenuity.

events.title: Chemi-Thone
events.description: Submit innovative solutions to an industry problem same-day; shortlisted teams present next day.

events.title: Soap Making
events.description: A fusion of science and art in soap crafting—discover quality control secrets.

events.title: Chemi-Mystery
events.description: An exploration of chemical enigmas through a tri-round quest.

events.title: Chemi Craft
events.description: Orchestrate a sequence of chemical reactions, judged on creativity, safety, and clarity.

events.description: Test how efficiently a truss design transfers force from load point to supports using minimal material.

events.description: A campus treasure hunt testing teamwork, logic, observation, and problem-solving.

events.title: Foodprint
events.description: Identify food and beverage brands from taglines, logos, and blurred pictures within limited time.

events.title: Tech4Earth
events.description: A knowledge-based quiz covering sustainability, climate change, green tech, AI, and space science.

events.title: The Big Bull (Diploma Students Only)
events.description: Answer questions and manage virtual coins, testing teamwork, decision-making, and risk. (Diploma Students Only)
